svg.text: t09 AG2 (two-agent chat), MAST-Data row 572: where the order's terms and the claims' status went
11 terms of the task-as-stated proxy and 7 claims; 10 links, of which 9 drawn
One run, read by a model, no second rater [C]; reconciled against the task-as-stated proxy, written before the run was read.
Columns: the order (L00), every link where a state changed, the commit. Red: narrowed, substituted, absent, softened, hardened, dropped, inverted.
Source: MAST-Data (CC BY 4.0), AG2 on Olympiad with GPT-4o; changed: scrubbed, split into links, read.
